source_text: De sacrificiis quae per unamquamque festivitatem iubentur. Rudimenta molesta sunt donec finis disciplinae ignoretur.
pass_a_gloss: Concerning sacrifices which through each festivity are-ordered. Rudiments troublesome are until end of-discipline is-unknown.
pass_b_english: On [[sacrifices ordered for each feast >> Bible:Numbers 28–29]]: rudiments feel heavy while the end of the discipline is unknown.
